description: Execute a SPARQL SELECT query against the Wikidata Query Service. Full graph power: multi-hop traversals, aggregations, subqueries, OPTIONAL, FILTER, UNION, BIND. Standard Wikidata prefixes (wd:, wdt:, p:, ps:, pq:, wikibase:, bd:, rdfs:, schema:) are auto-injected. The wikibase:label SERVICE is also auto-injected when the query references a ?<var>Label, ?<var>Description, or ?<var>AltLabel variable and declares no label SERVICE of its own — so you can use ?itemLabel without writing the boilerplate. Hard server timeout is 60s; use LIMIT to keep queries fast. Bindings use the SPARQL 1.1 JSON format: each value is { type, value, "xml:lang"?, datatype? }. Each response is held to 64,000 bytes, cut between whole rows: a larger result returns its leading rows with returnedCount and totalCount and a notice — page with ORDER BY plus LIMIT/OFFSET, or aggregate in the query. Use wikidata_get_labels to humanize QID results from this tool.

language.description: Wikidata language code, or a comma-separated fallback list tried in order (e.g., "en", "de", "fr,en"), for the injected wikibase:label SERVICE — the language of ?<var>Label, ?<var>Description, and ?<var>AltLabel variables. The list falls back to the multilingual ("mul") label last unless it already names mul. Case-insensitive; "_" is read as "-"; blank means "en".

query.description: SPARQL SELECT query. Any other form — ASK, CONSTRUCT, DESCRIBE, an update, or plain search text — is rejected before it is sent. Standard prefixes (wd:, wdt:, p:, ps:, pq:, wikibase:, bd:, rdfs:, schema:) are injected automatically. Example: SELECT ?item ?itemLabel WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q146. } LIMIT 10

timeout.description: Client-side timeout in seconds (1–55). Capped at 55s — the Wikidata server hard limit is 60s.

name: wikidata_sparql_query

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_select_query`: The query is not a SELECT query: an ASK, CONSTRUCT, DESCRIBE, or update form, or plain text. `parse_error`: SPARQL syntax error — the query could not be parsed. `timeout`: Query exceeded the client-side timeout. `throttled`: Wikidata SPARQL endpoint is rate-limited (60 req/min, 5 concurrent per IP). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present when the result was cut to fit the response budget (how to page or aggregate for the rest), or when no rows matched (check query logic or broaden filters).

results.description: Result bindings: every row when the result fits the 64,000-byte response budget, otherwise the leading rows that fit (returnedCount of totalCount). Each row maps variable names to binding objects with { type, value, "xml:lang"?, datatype? } fields.

returnedCount.description: Number of rows in results — fewer than totalCount when the 64,000-byte response budget cut the result.

totalCount.description: Number of rows the query produced, before any response-budget cut.

truncated.description: True when the query produced 10,000 rows (totalCount) — the Wikidata/Blazegraph server-side cap — indicating the result set was likely truncated upstream. False otherwise. Add a LIMIT clause to avoid hitting the cap. Independent of the response-budget cut, which returnedCount reports. Note: the SPARQL endpoint does not expose an explicit truncation flag; this is an inferred signal.

variables.description: Variable names returned by the SELECT clause.

title: Wikidata SPARQL Query
